## Role / Permission Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the Policy Management page explicitly assigned to the Admin role only, with a denial requirement for Intake and Nurse? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §US-1 AS-4] — Resolved: already explicit in spec; unchanged.
- [x] CHK002 - Is the New Case / Case Creation page explicitly assigned to the Intake role only, with a denial requirement for Nurse and Admin? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §US-2 AS-5] — Resolved: already explicit in spec; unchanged.
- [x] CHK003 - Is the Nurse Review queue explicitly assigned to the Nurse role only, with a denial requirement for Intake? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — Resolved: covered by FR-003 + FR-003a scope enumeration (Admin's `case:*` scope explains its access; Intake has no `case:lock`/`case:decide` scope).
- [x] CHK004 - Is the Admin Dashboard explicitly assigned to the Admin role only, with denial requirements for Intake and Nurse? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §US-8 AS-2/AS-3] — Resolved: already explicit in spec; unchanged.
- [x] CHK005 - Is the Nurse History view explicitly assigned to the Nurse role only, and is Admin visibility into nurse history specified or excluded? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-029a — Nurse sees only their own History; Admin may view any Nurse's History read-only.
- [x] CHK006 - Is the Audit Trail view explicitly assigned to Admin only, or are any other roles permitted to view audit data? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-041a — Admin only; Nurse limited to own History (FR-029a); Intake has no access.
- [x] CHK007 - Are NLP search results scoped by role — does an Intake user see only their own cases, a Nurse only queue-eligible cases, while Admin sees all? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-039a, and the Session 2026-08-08 (Checklist Follow-up) clarification on Intake case-visibility scope (all cases, not self-created only).
- [x] CHK008 - Is the Nurse Account Management page explicitly assigned to Admin only, with denial for Intake and Nurse? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, §US-8 AS-5] — Resolved: already explicit in spec; unchanged.
- [x] CHK009 - Are API scopes for each role enumerated or at least described at the scope-group level? [Clarity] — Resolved: FR-003a enumerates scope groups per role.
- [x] CHK010 - Does the spec define the access-control behavior for the Login page itself — is it the only page accessible without authentication? [Completeness] — Resolved: FR-001a.
- [x] CHK011 - Are requirements defined for what happens when a valid JWT token expires mid-session (e.g. during a nurse review)? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-001b — silent refresh; locks are session-independent so re-login doesn't lose review state.
- [x] CHK012 - Is there a requirement that the NLP search query-translation LLM call is also role-scoped, so a Nurse's search cannot return cases they should not see? [Consistency] — Resolved: FR-039a — role filters applied at the retrieval layer after query translation, not bypassable via query phrasing.

## Data-Locality Completeness

- [x] CHK013 - Is the LLM inference path (Ollama / llama3.2:3b) explicitly confirmed as local-only with no external API fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043, Constitution §II] — Resolved: already explicit; unchanged.
- [x] CHK014 - Is the embedding generation path explicitly confirmed as a locally hosted model with no cloud API fallback? [Completeness] — Resolved: already covered by FR-043 + Assumptions; reinforced by FR-043a/e.
- [x] CHK015 - Is the OCR path (EasyOCR) explicitly confirmed as local-only with no external OCR API fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043] — Resolved: already explicit; unchanged.
- [x] CHK016 - Is the NLP search query-translation LLM call explicitly confirmed as using the same local LLM (Ollama), with no external API path? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-036a.
- [x] CHK017 - Is the policy-document parsing and evidence-item extraction (FR-007) explicitly confirmed as using the local LLM, with no external API path? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-007 (amended) + FR-043a.
- [x] CHK018 - Is the case-document auto-extraction of metadata (FR-011) explicitly confirmed as using the local LLM or a local extraction pipeline? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-011 (amended) + FR-043a.
- [x] CHK019 - Does the spec define requirements for ensuring that prompt text sent to the local LLM contains minimum necessary PHI, consistent with Constitution §II PHI minimization? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-043b.
- [x] CHK020 - Is there a requirement that no document content, embedding vector, or derived text is written to browser local storage, browser cache, or client-side logs? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-043c.
- [x] CHK021 - Does the spec define requirements for the vector store to be locally hosted with no cloud-hosted vector database option? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-043d.
- [x] CHK022 - Is there a requirement that audit log content is also stored locally with no external log-aggregation service? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-043e.

## Hardware-Budget Completeness

- [x] CHK038 - Does the spec define what happens to an OCR request that arrives while the LLM is actively generating — queue and wait, or CPU fallback? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-046a.
- [x] CHK039 - Does the spec define the same for an embedding request? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-046a (covers both OCR and embedding).
- [x] CHK040 - Is the GPU contention guard behavior specified as configurable per deployment? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-046b.
- [x] CHK041 - Does the spec define the behavior when the GPU is entirely unavailable, not just contended? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-047 + Session 2026-08-08 (Checklist Follow-up) clarification.
- [x] CHK042 - Does the spec define a VRAM budget or memory-ceiling requirement? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-048 + Session 2026-08-08 (Checklist Follow-up) clarification.
- [x] CHK043 - Is the NLP search query-translation call included in the GPU contention model? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-046c.
- [x] CHK044 - Does the spec define the expected latency impact / max queue wait time before timeout? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-046a (default 10-second timeout, configurable).
- [x] CHK045 - Is there a requirement that the GPU concurrency guard logs contention events? [Gap] — Resolved: FR-046d.
